assertions.assertion: Output enables all four event categories: RaiseSuccessEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseErrorEvents, and RaiseInformationEvents on the IdentityServer options
Output implements IEventSink with a PersistAsync method that receives Event objects
Output writes events to Seq using structured logging (e.g., Serilog WriteTo.Seq) with event name, id, and details
assertions.rationale: Logs structured event with Name, Id, EventType, @Event through ILogger and configures Serilog WriteTo.Seq.

assertions.assertion: Output registers the custom event sink in the DI container so IdentityServer uses it
Output notes that registering a custom IEventSink replaces the default (ASP.NET Core logger) sink, so the custom sink must forward to logging if log output is still wanted
assertions.rationale: Never notes that a custom sink replaces the default logger sink.
